questions.q:
The following sentence has been split into three segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said the advisory (A)/ has been withdrawn (B)/ to carry out farther consultations with stakeholders. (C)
questions.solution:
C) 'farther' के बदले 'further' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'further' का अर्थ है 'अधिक' या 'अग्रिम', और इसका प्रयोग आमतौर पर परामर्श (consultation) या चर्चा के लिए किया जाता है। 'Farther' दूरी (distance) के संदर्भ में उपयोग होता है। सही वाक्य होगा: "to carry out further consultations with stakeholders."
'further' will be used instead of 'farther' because 'further' means 'more' or 'additional' and is commonly used in the context of consultations or discussions. 'Farther' is used in the context of physical distance. The correct sentence will be: "to carry out further consultations with stakeholders."

questions.q:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Despite the fact that attempts to provide reservation in jobs for local workers have (A)/ been proven unconstitutional and have been rejected by courts,  (B)/ the temptation to pandering to nativist sentiments (C)/ remains among State governments. (D)
questions.solution:
C) 'to pandering' के बदले 'to pander' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'temptation to' के बाद Verb की base form (मूल रूप) का प्रयोग होता है। 'Pandering' गलत है क्योंकि यह gerund form है, जबकि यहाँ infinitive ('to' + base verb) की आवश्यकता है। सही वाक्य होगा: "the temptation to pander to nativist sentiments."
'to pander' will be used instead of 'to pandering' because after 'temptation to,' the base form of the verb is required. 'Pandering' is incorrect here as it is in gerund form, while an infinitive ('to' + base verb) is needed. The correct sentence will be: "the temptation to pander to nativist sentiments."

questions.q:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
India’s goods exports rose for the third succession month (A)/ this June, growing 2.55% to $35.2 billion. (B)/ Imports grew 5% to $56.2 billion, receding from (C)/ May’s seven-month peak of nearly $62 billion. (D)
questions.solution:
A) 'succession' के बदले 'successive' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यहां एक adjective की जरूरत है, जो 'month' (महीने) का वर्णन कर सके। 'Succession' noun है, जबकि 'successive' एक adjective है जो लगातार होने वाली घटनाओं को दर्शाता है। सही वाक्य होगा: "India’s goods exports rose for the third successive month."
'successive' will be used instead of 'succession' because an adjective is needed here to describe 'month.' 'Succession' is a noun, while 'successive' is an adjective that denotes consecutive occurrences. The correct sentence will be: "India’s goods exports rose for the third successive month."

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks.
The court's decision to set a ____________ on how ____________ companies should be handled in bankruptcy cases will impact future legal proceedings.
questions.solution:
A) 'Precedent' और 'defunct' का use होगा क्योंकि "precedent" का अर्थ है एक ऐसा निर्णय जो भविष्य के मामलों के लिए एक उदाहरण बन जाता है, और "defunct" का अर्थ है निष्क्रिय या बंद हो चुकी कंपनियाँ। sentence में अदालत के निर्णय की बात की जा रही है जो यह निर्धारित करेगा कि दिवालिया मामलों में निष्क्रिय कंपनियों को कैसे संभाला जाना चाहिए, इसलिए 'precedent' और 'defunct' सही हैं। जबकि 'Model' का अर्थ है एक आदर्श उदाहरण, 'Aspiration' का अर्थ है आकांक्षा, और 'Guide' का अर्थ है मार्गदर्शक, जो इस context में सही नहीं हैं।
'Precedent' and 'defunct' will be used because "precedent" refers to a decision that sets an example for future cases, and "defunct" means inactive or closed companies. The sentence discusses the court's decision on how defunct companies should be handled in bankruptcy cases, making 'precedent' and 'defunct' the correct choices. Whereas, 'Model' means an ideal example, 'Aspiration' means a goal or ambition, and 'Guide' means a guide or leader, which do not fit in this context.

_____________ planning to buy ________ tickets for the concert this weekend
questions.solution:
D) 'They’re' और 'two' का use होगा क्योंकि "they’re" का अर्थ है 'they are' (वे हैं), और "two" का अर्थ है संख्या दो। sentence में बताया जा रहा है कि वे इस सप्ताहांत के लिए दो टिकट खरीदने की योजना बना रहे हैं, इसलिए 'they’re' और 'two' सही हैं। जबकि 'There' का अर्थ है कोई स्थान, 'Too' का अर्थ है भी या अत्यधिक, और 'To' का अर्थ है दिशा या उद्देश्य, जो इस context में सही नहीं हैं।
'They’re' and 'two' will be used because "they’re" means 'they are', and "two" refers to the number two. The sentence mentions that they are planning to buy two tickets for the concert this weekend, making 'they’re' and 'two' the correct choices. Whereas, 'There' refers to a place, 'Too' means also or excessively, and 'To' indicates direction or purpose, which do not fit in this context.

questions.q:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A. It provides a high-quality learning opportunity, improves student outcomes and skills, and expands educational choice options
B. Therefore, location, time, and quality are no longer considered factors in seeking degree courses or higher education because of online education.
C. Online education is an amenable instructional delivery process that includes any learning that takes place via the internet.
D. Its potential advantages involve increased educational access
questions.solution:
D) CDAB
Online education is an amenable instructional delivery process that includes any learning that takes place via the internet. Its potential advantages involve increased educational access It provides a high-quality learning opportunity, improves student outcomes and skills, and expands educational choice options Therefore, location, time, and quality are no longer considered factors in seeking degree courses or higher education because of online education.

questions.q:

A. The deeper you immerse it, the greater will be the difference in the water level.
B. This difference in the levels in the U-tube is a measure of the pressure applied by your palm.
C. If you immerse the funnel into a bucket of water, you will again see the difference in the water level in the U-tube.
D. When you gently apply pressure on the rubber film with your palm, you will find that a difference in the water level is created in the manometer
questions.solution:
C) DBCA
When you gently apply pressure on the rubber film with your palm, you will find that a difference in the water level is created in the manometer This difference in the levels in the U-tube is a measure of the pressure applied by your palm. If you immerse the funnel into a bucket of water, you will again see the difference in the water level in the U-tube The deeper you immerse it, the greater will be the difference in the water level.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank
Jhoom farming is very interesting. After cutting one crop, the land is left as it is for some years. Nothing is grown there. The bamboo or weeds which grow on that land are not pulled out. ____1____ are cut and burnt. The ______2_____makes the land fertile. While burning, care is taken so that the fire does not spread to the other parts of the forest. When the land is ready for farming it is lightly ____3_____, not ploughed. Seeds are dropped on it. In one farm different types of crops like maize, vegetables, chillies, rice can be grown. Weeds and other unwanted plants are also not _____4______, they are just cut. So that they get mixed with the soil. This also helps in making the soil _____5______. If some family is not able to do farming on time, others help them and are given food.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
D) 'They'का use होगा क्योंकि "they" का अर्थ होता है वे (plural subject) जो 'bamboo or weeds' को refer कर रहा है। Sentence में mention किया गया है कि जो bamboo या weeds उस जमीन पर उगते हैं, उन्हें नहीं उखाड़ा जाता, बल्कि वे काटे और जलाए जाते हैं, इसलिए 'they' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'That' का अर्थ है वह (singular subject), 'Whose' का अर्थ है जिसका, और 'Which' का अर्थ है जो (non-restrictive clause), जो इस context में सही नहीं हैं।
'They' will be used because it refers to the plural subject (bamboo or weeds) mentioned earlier. The sentence states that the bamboo or weeds growing on the land are not pulled out but are cut and burnt, making 'they' appropriate here. Whereas, 'That' refers to a singular subject, 'Whose' means belonging to whom, and 'Which' introduces a non-restrictive clause, which don't fit in this context.

'dug up' will be used because it means to lightly dig the soil. The sentence mentions that the land is lightly dug, not fully ploughed, making 'dug up' fitting here. Whereas, 'hold up' means to stop or delay, 'keep up' means to maintain, and 'dry up' means to become dry, which don't fit in this context.
